newsitem.title: USA: Effective says IBM shifts sales approach.
newsitem.headline: Effective says IBM shifts sales approach.

text.p: Software maker Effective Management Systems Inc said late Thursday that International Business Machines Corp has informed the company and other IBM partners that is is moving away from the direct selling of the partners' Enterprise Resource Planning software.
IBM is moving toward a cooperative marketing alliance, Effective Management said.
Effective Management said the shift in strategy does not suggest a reduced commitment by IBM.

"Our very substantial growth in revenue over the last couple of years has been achieved independently from this program with IBM," says Michael Dunham, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Company representatives were not immediately available to discuss how this would specifically affect revenues.

"We have made an investment in Effective Management Systems infrastructure associated with this program over the past two years. While we are disappointed that a part of our initial investment will not be leveraged to the extent that we had hoped, we are pleased that EMS and IBM will continue to strengthen our overall relationship," Dunham said.
